summary.text: Parnell Terry is a Democratic state representative from Maine House District 108, in office since December 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Kelly Dearborn. He works as a facilities maintenance technician.

paragraphs.text: Terry graduated from Mount View High School in 1985 and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine.
His career experience includes working as a facilities maintenance technician.
He took office on December 3, 2024, succeeding Maureen Terry.
